subject.title: fix(qa): harden Mantis Telegram proof harness

question: Should Mantis Telegram Desktop proof remain manual-dispatch-only after this PR removes the existing comment and label activation paths?
rationale: This is an intentional change to how repository automation reaches a workflow that prepares and executes candidate worktrees; code review cannot determine the repository’s desired availability-versus-exposure policy.

options.title: Adopt manual-only dispatch
options.body: Keep `workflow_dispatch` as the sole trigger and update every supported Mantis request path so maintainers explicitly initiate proof runs.

options.title: Retain a guarded request trigger
options.body: Restore a narrowly authorized comment or label trigger if maintainers require Mantis requests to launch proof automatically.

recommendation.title: Adopt manual-only dispatch
recommendation.body: Keep `workflow_dispatch` as the sole trigger and update every supported Mantis request path so maintainers explicitly initiate proof runs.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commits place this contributor closest to the current workflow design and its intended trigger policy.
